summary: Latah County, Idaho crow's nest dated c.1934 and run by the Clearwater Timber Protective Association; abandoned in the 1940s; exact location unknown; no source describes the site today.

facts.status_note: Abandoned in the 1940s; exact location unknown, and no source describes what remains today

visit.trail_note: Idaho Fire Lookouts labels the site a hike-in but gives the exact location as unknown

events.note: Crow's nest; the Forest Lookouts site dates it c.1934 and attributes the date to Kresek
Sources say abandoned in the 1940s; 1940 is the record's year and is approximate

evidence.supports: crow's nest in 1934; abandoned in the 1940s

corrections.why: Idaho Fire Lookouts says the exact location is unknown, so exact precision is not supported; the second record coordinate (46.71295, -116.3851) also disagrees with this point

notes_for_editor: Two record coordinates disagree (ffla 46.7025, -116.3937 vs idaho_fl 46.71295, -116.3851), and Idaho Fire Lookouts says the exact location is unknown, so the record's point is unconfirmed. Proposed correction is precision only; no coordinate is proposed. Sources say abandoned in the 1940s; the record's 1940 is approximate. Only Forest Lookouts gives the full agency name; the other two give CTPA. The Forest Lookouts date is attributed to Kresek, and the 1934 crow's nest is the only design described. One WebSearch found nothing on this lookout. Access, condition and staffing are unknown and omitted from facts.
